context: Asuka and Mei discuss a novel and its critic.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: literature chat; book vocabulary (小説/コラム/解説/人物/著) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この小説、人物の描き方が見事ですね。
lines.en: In this novel, the characters are wonderfully drawn.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 著者は、人の心をよく知っていますね。
lines.en: The author knows the human heart well.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 新聞のコラムに、解説が載っていました。
lines.en: There was commentary in a newspaper column.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その解説は、人物の弱さを論じていましたか?
lines.en: Did that commentary discuss the characters' weakness?
lines.style: curious teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はい、著者の意図も説明していました。
lines.en: Yes, it explained the author's intent too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm thoughtful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良いコラムは、小説をより豊かにしますね。
lines.en: A good column enriches a novel.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 解説のおかげで、人物が深く見えました。
lines.en: Thanks to the commentary, the characters looked deeper.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 著者の他の小説も、読みたくなりますね。
lines.en: It makes you want to read the author's other novels.
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm reflective closing clarity throughout
